answer: What survives to the gale is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the jade of a task receipt, and the falcon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
